name: Modern
title: Free Modern Invoice Template
description: A free modern invoice template set in a clean grotesque, with your logo, line items and a clear amount due. Fill it in online and download a professional PDF.
summary: The Classic arrangement set in Grotesk: crisper, more contemporary, equally formal.
intro: The proven letterhead arrangement, set entirely in a clean grotesque. Crisp on a phone screen, formal on paper.
explanation: Many clients first open an invoice on a phone. A sans-serif at the right weight stays crisp at small sizes, and a semibold amount due is easy to find with a thumb and a glance.

This template keeps the arrangement of the [Classic template](/invoice-templates/classic/), letterhead left and number right, and sets everything in Hanken Grotesk, with names and totals in semibold. Nothing else changes, so it is just as easy to read and process.
It suits digital studios, technology freelancers, startups and any business whose own branding uses a sans-serif.

fields.name: Letterhead
fields.text: Logo and business name top left, with your contact line beneath.

fields.name: Invoice number
fields.text: Opposite the letterhead, in the same clean face.

fields.name: Key facts
fields.text: Billed to, issue date, due date and amount due on one line, the amount in semibold.

fields.name: Items
fields.text: Description, quantity, price and amount. Works for one line or forty; long invoices continue on further pages.

fields.name: Totals
fields.text: Subtotal, discount, tax, other charges and the total, right-aligned.

fields.name: Payment and notes
fields.text: Bank details or a payment link, and a short note, at the foot.

steps.title: Open the example
steps.text: Customize this invoice opens the modern example in the generator.

steps.title: Your details
steps.text: Add your business details and logo once; they carry over to new invoices.

steps.title: Items and totals
steps.text: Add the client and the work. Totals are calculated as you type.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the PDF or print it. Only the invoice is printed.

faqs.q: What makes an invoice template modern?
faqs.a: Mostly typography and restraint: a contemporary sans-serif, generous spacing, few rules and no decoration. The structure should still be conventional, so clients find everything where they expect it.

faqs.q: Is a sans-serif invoice less formal?
faqs.a: Not if it is set carefully. This template keeps a formal arrangement; only the typeface changes.

faqs.q: Will it look the same on my client’s computer?
faqs.a: Yes. The PDF embeds the typeface, so it doesn’t depend on the fonts your client has installed.

faqs.q: Can I use my brand colors?
faqs.a: Folio’s templates are deliberately black on white, which prints well and looks consistent. Your logo carries your brand.
